author: Original Auto-Doc guide author in commit 79812286; proofreading in 019591c7; corrections by DOC-029 source-review author agent (auto-docs)

prerequisites: Seeded fictional Administrator account signed in on the admin documentation lab.

Reviewer-created Word fixtures retained in docs/documentation/batches/DOC-029/auto-docs/fixtures (build-fixtures.py adds an endnote part, a header-only Placeholder, a date directive, an upper directive, and refusal files).
scenarios.expected: Upload marks Placeholders and Blocks in the body, header, footer, footnote, and endnote; new fields follow the pane order with the body first; directives set the new field type; field and Clause edits persist; re-upload keeps and marks the orphan; Publish pins the chosen pair. An unclosed Block, an unclosed brace, an invalid slug, an unknown directive, two directives on one Placeholder, and a directive/type mismatch are refused with the offending text.
scenarios.actual: 23 recorded steps passed for this role on 3fa407e3. The pane showed Body, then Endnotes, Footer, Footnotes and Header, with a chip for each Placeholder. The 8 new fields followed that order, so the endnote, footer and header-only fields came after every body field. date:DD/MM/YYYY created a Date field, currency:USD a Currency field, and the others Text; upper uploaded without refusal. Label, type and help edits and a Governing law Clause rule persisted. The upload refusals quoted {{#block arbitration}}, {{counterparty_name on the date below.", {{Counterparty-Name}}, {{counterparty_name|lower}}, {{counterparty_name|upper|upper}} and {{fee_amount|currency:ZZZ}}. Publish with Fee amount set to Text was refused and named the field and its Placeholder. File version 2 kept Signing date marked No Placeholder in file version 2. Publish pinned file version 2 / form version 8, and a later edit left that live pair unchanged. Removing a field whose Placeholder remains opened a guard; removing the orphan did not. The template pane Help link opened /help/auto-doc-template. The Administrator also saw two directives that disagree on one name create a Text field, and Publish named both gaps.

limitations: Independent agent walkthrough by a different agent from the author; not a human user study and not feature-owner approval.
Both roles ran the same scripted procedure. Only the Administrator ran the supplementary two-directives check.

The lab Help route serves the article as committed at 3fa407e3 (sha256 13355e7d...). The reviewed bytes (8b4d7dd3...) differ only in the Mark a Placeholder sentences on scanned parts and field order. The Help link check proves the route and title, not the new wording; the new wording was checked against the Form section.

Printed output of upper, date and currency directives was not checked, because that needs a generated document. The walkthrough checked only upload acceptance and the field type each directive creates.
The 120-character slug limit and comment parts not being scanned were checked in source only (see technical-review.json), not in the browser.
Negative access check used ravi.menon, who has the business_user role in this lab (confirmed from /api/v1/me), not a Contributor. It landed on /portal and the Auto-Doc API answered 403.
Help contrast was seen in the default theme only. Keyboard and 390 px checks are script measurements, not a screen-reader session.
The admin lab is shared with other DOC-029 agents. This walkthrough created only Auto-Docs named DOC-029 auto-docs * and changed no organisation settings. Nothing was deleted.

Three earlier round 1 runs are kept as walkthrough-r1-attempt1.json to attempt3.json. Attempts 1 and 2 failed on reviewer script errors (a chip count and a field list that counted the Clauses button; a password sign-in for an account without a password). Attempt 3 passed but looked up the role on a wrong API path. The dispositions are in walkthrough-r1.json.

compatibilityReview.summary: From 3fa407e3 to 57e77e38, round 2 (DOC-029r2 compatibility reviewer (auto-docs)) found the article compatible: The app diff from 3fa407e3 to 57e77e38 changes no Auto-Doc code; the shared ListEditor change adds optional props and an inline add-row guard that the Fields and Clauses cards do not use, and no label the article names changed. The full round 1 V-C56 walkthrough replayed on the admin2 lab built from 57e77e38 and passed all 44 steps for the Administrator, the Legal Team Member and the non-legal check. From 57e77e38 to 432dba3a, round 3 found only apps/web/src/routes/welcome.tsx and its test changed. The wizard now goes to /auth/two-factor/enroll after it saves a policy that requires two-factor authentication. The article makes no statement about the setup wizard Authentication step or two-factor enrollment. The change touches only apps/web/src/routes/welcome.tsx and its test, so no statement in the article can become wrong.
